turns.reply:
I added broken-pipe handling to `rich/console.py`; the 97 tests in `tests/test_console.py` pass and the patch is submitted.

The buffer write moved into a new `_write_buffer()` method. `_check_buffer()` now calls it and catches `BrokenPipeError`, which routes to a new `Console.on_broken_pipe()`. That method sets `quiet`, redirects stdout to devnull, and raises `SystemExit(1)`.

I did not write a test that reproduces a real broken pipe, and the issue text did not give exact names or messages, so `on_broken_pipe` and the `SystemExit(1)` behaviour are my best reading of the issue.
